fields.Name: T241 - Delete Conversation
fields.Description: Exercises the single-conversation delete + confirm dialog path — distinct from bulk-delete selection mode and from generic entity-grid delete.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Chat application and wait for the workspace. In the left sidebar, open a conversation's '...' (more options) menu and click 'Delete'. Confirm the deletion if a confirmation prompt appears. Verify the conversation is removed from the sidebar list. If no conversations exist, first create one by sending a message, then delete it. The conversation disappearing from the list after confirmation is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The conversation '...' menu offers a 'Delete' option (styled as a destructive action)
A confirmation step appears and, once confirmed, the conversation is removed from the sidebar list
The list re-renders correctly after deletion (no orphaned/broken row)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
